title: attestation-as-code-sdk-and-risk-aware-pricing-playbook-for-procurement
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Build and pilot an "attestation-as-code" SDK + vendor portal integration that reduces manual questionnaire review and enables a dynamic pricing playbook: vendors submit cryptographically-signed attestation bundles (e.g., SOC2 evidence snippets, insurance certs, policy pointers) that our procurement rules engine evaluates to assign a risk tier and an associated onboarding pricing/contract addendum. Goal: shorten procurement time, reduce legal coordination, and provide measurable insurance-offset credits in enterprise pricing experiments.
updates: 2025-02-18: Kickoff meeting with Product, Security, Legal, and Engineering. Agreed scope: SDK v0 for attestation bundles, scoring rules for 3 risk tiers, UI flows for portal and contract addendum generator.
2025-02-23: Security provided data model for evidence items and acceptable signatures. Legal reviewed initial contract templates and suggested modular addenda for SLA/insurance offsets.
2025-02-28: Engineering spike complete: prototype SDK accepts JSON-LD attestation and returns canonical digest; PoC GH branch created: github.com/redwood/procurement/attest-sdk/poc.

2025-03-03: PM ran first pricing simulation using historical vendor data: estimated 18% reduction in time-to-onboard for low-risk vendors and potential 6% uplift in net-new enterprise deals when paired with a 5% insurance credit.

2025-03-05: Design crit held for portal UX. Decision: inline evidence checklist with progress % and automated caching of repeated attestations across vendors from the same parent company. Next: implement gating rules in rules-engine (ENG-8942 dependency).
To do: implement SDK telemetry, run closed beta with 5 partners, finalize legal addendum language, instrument conversion metrics in Mixpanel and Console.
acceptance_criteria: SDK accepts signed attestation bundles and returns canonical digest and structured evidence summary
Rules engine maps evidence summary to one of three risk tiers with explanation strings
Portal shows live onboarding progress, pricing addendum preview, and supports download of generated addendum PDF
Closed beta with 5 vendors completed and we observe >=15% reduction in average manual-review time for low-risk vendors
Legal-approved contract addendum templates stored in Drive and linkable from portal
